item.title: Apps & Connections
item.content:
Each item in apps is a provider definition with a details block (display information) and a connection block (how HAX talks to the provider).

details fields

  • title — provider display label.
  • icon — icon used in the HAX UI.
  • color — accent color for the provider card.
  • author — provider owner / source.
  • description — short description shown in the UI.
  • status — provider state (commonly available).
  • tags — searchable categorization terms.
  • tos — optional terms / policy links.

connection fields

  • protocol — http or https.
  • url — provider host and base path, without the protocol.
  • headers — optional request headers.
  • data — default query values sent with every operation.
  • auto — optional boolean, default true: run the browse request as soon as the app is activated.
  • operations — browse (required) and optionally add. HAX does not read any other operation names.

When the HAXcms platform setting disables onlineMedia, only apps with an add operation are loaded.

Build URLs the way HAX does: protocol + "://" + url + "/" + endPoint. So connection.url has no protocol, and an operation's endPoint has no leading slash.

Never commit real credentials. Use a {{NAME}} placeholder the backend fills in, or broker the request through your backend (HAXcms does this). site_token in data is sent as the X-HAXCMS-Site-Token header, and a HAXcms session JWT is added as an Authorization: Bearer header automatically.
